sql: SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*0\.60[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '18068514' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%0.60%' LIMIT 5
